purpose: Quantify conditional score sensitivity to hypothetical recorded-label errors; not clinical adjudication.
m_rule: floor(rate * number of original positive labels); each arm uses this same integer count.

families.balanced_exchange: m original positives to negative AND m original negatives to positive; prevalence unchanged.
families.positive_to_negative_only: m original positives to negative, with no opposite changes; prevalence decreases.
families.negative_to_positive_only: m original negatives to positive, with no opposite changes; prevalence increases.

unit: Native analytic row: patient in SCH/WHU, admission in MIMIC. Repeated admissions are not constrained to share a hypothetical change.
bounds: Exact deterministic minimum/maximum fixed-score AUC over exactly the stipulated number of changes in each class, using average ranks for ties.
paired_comparison: Patient-isolated primary_raw minus historical original on identical rows with one shared hypothetical label perturbation; optimize the rank difference.
restrictions: Rates are hypothetical scenario budgets, not observed or plausible clinical error-rate estimates.
Bounds are not confidence or credible intervals and have no probability interpretation.
Labels used to train the frozen models are unchanged; this does not evaluate refitting under corrected labels.
No clinical reviewer has classified these scenarios; no synthetic label vector is stored or substituted into the primary dataset.
No event timing, future-event prediction, independent clinical truth, common endpoints or clinical utility are certified.
Extrema for two separately reported models need not arise from the same perturbation; the paired contrast has its own shared perturbation.
